title: Treatment area assignments
description: Which treatment areas are set up at a mass casualty incident, by priority, with the location, the leader, the staff, the number of patients held and what the area still needs.

agency.description: Agency or unit that keeps this record.

incidentName.description: Incident name as command announced it.

marking.description: Exercise marking printed at the top and bottom. Defaults to the standard exercise marking.

leader.description: Name and unit of the person in charge of treatment.

morgueLocation.description: Where deceased patients are held, as agreed with the medical examiner.
examples: Fellowship hall, north entrance (agreed with the medical examiner)

totalHeld.description: Number of patients across all areas.

priority.description: Triage priority of the patients in this area.

staff.description: Unit or crew running the area.

notes.description: Moves between areas, hazards or reassessment times.
examples: Re-triage of the yellow area every 15 minutes. T-004 moved to red at 10:44 after a drop in blood pressure.
